plugins/batch_file_tools/.claude-plugin/.summary: Plugin registration metadata for batch_file_tools MCP server v1.2.4. Declares package info, keywords (tokens, efficiency, file-reading, context-optimization), homepage/repository in better-base-tools. No dependencies.

plugins/batch_file_tools/CHANGELOG.md.summary: Comprehensive version history (22 releases, v0.1.0–v1.2.4, 2026-06-07). Major features: batch read/edit ops, deduplication, glob expansion, fileinfo metadata, regex search with context merging, normalization, dry-run, config args/env vars, MCP progress/logging, structured content. Breaking changes documented.

plugins/batch_file_tools/CLAUDE.md.summary: Usage guidelines for batch_file_tools plugin. Two key directives: (1) Always use batch_read and batch_edit instead of built-in Read/Edit/Write tools. (2) Bundle related operations into single calls before reading/editing to minimize round-trips and context noise.

plugins/batch_file_tools/hooks/hooks.jso.summary: Hook configuration for batch_file_tools SessionStart event. Registers a single hook that executes node script session-start.js at plugin root. Enables automatic startup checks and guidance injection on session start.

plugins/batch_file_tools/hooks/session-s.summary: Node.js session-start hook validating MCP build availability. Checks CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, verifies dist/index.js exists, returns JSON with instructions directing users to batch_read/batch_edit over native tools. Single 52-line file.

plugins/batch_file_tools/LICENSE.summary: MIT License for batch_file_tools plugin. Copyright 2026 Thore Höltig. Standard MIT terms allowing free use, modification, and distribution with liability disclaimer.

plugins/batch_file_tools/README.md.summary: Complete documentation covering why batching (−58% tool calls, −46% context), mode reference (compact/verbatim/fileinfo), glob/search features, error recovery with nearest_anchor hints, 8 env var config options, performance benchmarks across real projects. ~1400 lines.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/package.summary: Lockfile (v3) for batch-tools-mcp-server 0.1.0. Locks 100+ direct and transitive deps including @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0, zod 3.25.76, typescript 5.9.3, vitest 4.1.5. Captures exact versions and integrity hashes for reproducible installs. Node >=22 required. Essential for build reproducibility and dependency security.

NPM package metadata v1.2.4. Bin entry to dist/index.js. Runtime deps: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0, zod 3.25.76. Dev deps: typescript 5.9.3, vitest 4.1.5, @types/node 25.0.1. Node >=22. Build/test/inspect scripts.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/ind.summary: MCP server entrypoint (~400 lines). Registers batch_read and batch_edit tools. Parses config (env vars/args: logging, dry-run, formatting, fileinfo, meta). Implements elicitation workflow for unauthorized paths with session allow-list (read/edit separate). Progress reporting, MCP logging, process shutdown (stdin/SIGTERM/SIGINT), roots notification handler.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/lib.summary: In-memory edit buffer management for file operations. Loads and tracks file state (existed, exists, lines, endings), lazily reads content on demand, and provides write operations with parent directory creation. Handles ENOENT gracefully for new files.

Core edit operation executor applying replace, replace_all, insert_at_line, replace_range, append, and overwrite to file buffers. Handles exact and fuzzy (whitespace-normalized) matching, generates helpful error hints with nearest anchors, tracks byte/line changes, and maintains file state integrity through in-place mutations.

Formatting layer that converts ReadOutput and EditOutput into tool-consumable ToolContentResult blocks with annotations. Handles different output modes (assistant/user audience), error display with anchors and match hints, and concise summarization of operation outcomes.

Utility module for extracting file references from code and markdown content. Uses regex patterns to identify imports, requires, markdown links, and path literals. Filters out non-file URLs and package names, returning a deduplicated sorted array of relative/absolute file references.

File system access layer with authorization guards. Provides safe read/write path resolution with permission checking against allowed directories. Handles symlink resolution, home directory expansion, and detailed error mapping for common fs errors (ENOENT, EISDIR, EACCES).

File system globbing module using Node fs/promises API. Expands glob patterns and directory paths into sorted lists of absolute, symlink-resolved file paths. Provides utilities to detect glob syntax and check if paths need expansion (directories or patterns).

Line-aware text processing module preserving exact byte boundaries and line endings. Provides split/join operations, CRLF vs LF detection, line ending conversion, and normalized string matching. Supports byte-exact round-tripping for mixed-ending files.

Edit hint generation using Levenshtein distance for fuzzy matching. Finds nearest-similar lines when exact anchors fail, builds unique context windows around errors, and provides helpful suggestions for re-reading or widening anchors in edit operations.

Content formatting for different read modes. Compact mode strips whitespace and collapses lines for non-indent-sensitive files; minifies JSON; preserves indentation for Python/YAML/Makefiles. Verbatim mode normalizes indent (tabs to spaces) while preserving byte exactness. Supports sliced reads with offset/limit.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/too.summary: Core implementation of handleBatchEdit orchestrating multi-file, multi-op edits. Manages file planning with glob expansion, authorization checks, two-phase execution (line-addressed ops sorted DESC, content ops in order), overlap detection, buffer loading/writing. Handles stopOnError at root/file/op levels with proper cascading. Generates detailed error results with near-match hints and line-addressable anchors.

Core batch read handler (~700 lines). Implements request deduplication (fileinfo/search/range merging), glob expansion, file caching, search with regex+context-block merging (SEARCH_MERGE_GAP=3), fileinfo metadata (size/lines/lastChanged/refs extraction), multiple read modes with formatting normalization, offset/count pagination.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/src/typ.summary: Central Zod schema definitions. ReadInput/Output/Request/Result with modes (compact/verbatim/fileinfo). EditInput/Output with ops (replace/replace_all/insert_at_line/replace_range/write). Error reasons, ToolContentResult formatting, validation for batch operations. ~400 lines.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/a.summary: Vitest suite validating authorization for read and edit operations. Tests rejection of files outside allowed directories, empty allowedDirectories list, and not_found vs not_authorized distinction. Covers auth edge cases: non-existent files outside allowed dirs, write prevention outside boundaries, and nested path creation inside allowed scope.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/e.summary: Vitest suite for stopOnError behavior and dryRun mode. Tests three-level stopOnError resolution (op > file > root) with cascading abort logic. Validates dryRun reports success without disk modification. Tests output format: status='ok' with empty ops, partial status with only failed ops, error status with error blocks. Covers file-level and root-level abort propagation.

Vitest suite testing fuzzy whitespace fallback for replace operations. Validates Phase 4 compose behavior: 2-space normalized reads match tab/4-space indented files via fuzzy matching. Tests exact-match path priority, content difference detection, deeply nested blocks, and single-line substring matches with indent preservation.

Comprehensive vitest suite for edit operations: write (create/overwrite/append), insert_at_line, replace_range, replace, replace_all, and delete. Tests phased execution with proper line number references, CRLF preservation, overlapping op detection, batch edits across multiple files. Covers fuzzy matching fallback, ambiguous replacements with nearest_anchor hints, and line-ending auto-match behavior.

Comprehensive tests for read/edit output formatting. Validates result enveloping with proper metadata headers, error annotations with nearest anchors and match line hints, file-level vs op-level errors, and dry-run formatting. Tests user/assistant audience annotations and summary generation.

Unit tests for extract-refs module covering import/require patterns, markdown links, relative paths, Windows paths, npm package filtering, deduplication, and sorting. Validates regex patterns correctly identify file references while ignoring URLs and package names.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/g.summary: Vitest suite for glob expansion in edit operations. Tests glob patterns matching flat/nested directories, single-level vs recursive expansion (**), incompatible ops detection, match outcomes (0 matches, outside allowed dirs). Validates deduplication across path separators/case, op merging when glob resolves to concrete paths, per-file error reporting.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/l.summary: Unit tests for line-aware text processing. Validates split/join round-tripping with mixed CRLF/LF, line counting, empty file handling, and newline preservation. Ensures byte-exact round-trip capability for files with varying line endings.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/r.summary: Comprehensive vitest suite for handleBatchRead function. Tests cover multiple read modes (verbatim, compact, fileinfo), pagination with offset/count, search functionality with context blocks, glob expansion, deduplication logic, symlink handling, and error scenarios. Validates mode coalescing, result merging for overlapping ranges, and authorization checks.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/s.summary: Tests for fuzzy matching and anchor suggestion. Validates Levenshtein distance calculation, nearest-line finding via similarity scoring, anchor window building with proper whitespace skipping, and uniqueness checking. Tests edge cases: files near size limit, repeating patterns, out-of-range lines.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tests/t.summary: Unit tests for content formatting across read modes. Tests compact mode collapsing (JS/TS to single line, Python/YAML preserve indent), JSON minification, verbatim mode byte-exactness, indent normalization (tabs→spaces, 4→2 spaces), and CRLF preservation. Covers slicing, offset/limit behavior, and edge cases.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/tsconfi.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for batch_file_tools scripts. Targets ES2022 with strict type checking enabled, including exact optional properties and unknown catch variables. Output compiled to dist/ from src/. Generates source maps and declarations for full type safety.

plugins/batch_file_tools/scripts/vitest..summary: Vitest test runner configuration for batch_file_tools scripts. Runs tests from tests/**/*.test.ts files in Node.js environment. Minimal setup providing baseline for TypeScript unit and integration test execution.

plugins/project-intel-tool/.claude-plugi.summary: Plugin registration metadata v1.4.3. Describes lightweight reconnaissance system for pre-exploration direction. Keywords: tokens, efficiency, exploration, codebase, reconnaissance, semantic. Dependencies: none. Homepage/repo in better-base-tools.

plugins/project-intel-tool/.mcp.json.summary: MCP server configuration for project-intel-tool. Registers project-intel-tool as MCP server executed via Node.js, pointing to compiled dist/index.js script in plugin root. Enables integration with Claude harness for tool invocation.

plugins/project-intel-tool/CHANGELOG.md.summary: Version history v0.1.0–v1.4.3 (2026-05-27 to 2026-06-07), 20+ releases. Major features: scan/query tools, semantic file analysis, subagent workflow, batch clustering via cohesion, role-based filtering, import structure overhaul (string[]→Record), verbosity (full/structure/semantic), analysis delta tracking, ref extraction, file lock. Breaking changes documented.

plugins/project-intel-tool/hooks/hooks.j.summary: Hook configuration for project-intel-tool SessionStart event. Registers Node.js command to execute sessionstart.js hook script, which validates tool installation and triggers knowledge base initialization on session startup.

plugins/project-intel-tool/hooks/session.summary: Node.js hook script for SessionStart event. Validates CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT environment variable and checks if sessionstart-knowledge-check.js is built. Spawns the knowledge check subprocess and relays stdio/exit code. Provides actionable error if build is missing.

plugins/project-intel-tool/LICENSE.summary: MIT License for project-intel-tool. Grants rights to use, modify, distribute under conditions of attribution and liability disclaimer. Copyright holder is Thore Höltig (2026).

plugins/project-intel-tool/README.md.summary: Comprehensive documentation for project-intel-tool, an MCP server providing persistent project knowledge indexing. Explains structural and semantic data models, file scanning, analysis batching, query scoring, token savings vs exploration agents, session start automation, configuration options, best practices, and troubleshooting.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/index.summary: Main MCP server entry point for project-intel-tool. Orchestrates tool registration (scan, query, submit_analysis), manages locks, handles subagent and MCP sampling modes, supports progress reporting, configuration parsing, and resource cleanup. Routes scan/query requests to respective libraries.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/a.summary: Helper module that prepares sampling batches by combining scan results with existing summaries. Calls buildFileMap and buildSamplingBatches to produce AI analysis workload.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/c.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for config.ts using Vitest. Tests parseConfigArg priority rules (env>argv>default), bare flags, and parseConfigArgRecord JSON parsing with error handling.

Provides command-line and environment variable configuration parsing utilities. Exports parseConfigArg (priority: env > argv > default) and parseConfigArgRecord (JSON object parsing from env/argv). Used throughout the project for flexible runtime configuration.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/f.summary: Extensive test suite for file-map.ts covering TypeScript/JS import resolution, C# using directives, markdown link parsing, and text-file path mentions. 30+ test cases validating all code paths and edge cases.

Core file analysis module that parses TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, and text files to extract imports, exports, and internal file references. Builds complete dependency graphs via buildFileMap and parseFileRefs using regex patterns for various module systems.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/l.summary: Unit tests for lock.ts validating lock acquisition, release, and timeout behavior. Tests include process staleness detection, corrupt lock recovery, and concurrent lock conflicts.

File locking mechanism for coordinating concurrent analysis jobs. Implements acquireLock and acquireSubmitLock with process staleness detection (1-hour timeout). Prevents race conditions when multiple scanners write to summaries.json.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/p.summary: Orchestrates project scanning by detecting file changes via git or filesystem mtime. Integrates file-map, summary-merger, and lock modules. Manages deleted files, sub-knowledge refs, and incremental analysis updates with delta metrics.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/q.summary: Tests query-engine.ts covering confidence scoring algorithms, flat/grouped output generation, verbosity filters, and fluent text rendering. 20+ tests validating semantic weight application and format conversions.

Implements full-text search scoring across file summaries with semantic weighting. Supports grouped/flat output formats with multiple verbosity levels. Calculates confidence scores based on summary, keywords, exports, imports, and technologies.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/lib/s.summary: Tests sampler.ts batching logic including topological ordering, circular dependency handling, token budgeting, and context file inclusion. Validates that every file appears in exactly one batch.

Batches files for AI analysis using token-budget-aware batching with topological sorting of dependencies. Builds context from already-analyzed files and manages sampling prompts. Integrates with MCP sampling/createMessage endpoint.
Tests summary-merger.ts with focus on persistence, path normalization, key collision resolution, and deleted-file tracking. Validates round-trip serialization and sorted output for stable diffs.

Manages persistence of file summaries to summaries.json. Provides getOrCreateSummaries (with path normalization), writeSummaries (minified JSON), mergeSamplingResults, and markFilesAsDeleted. Handles absolute/relative path conversions.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/packa.summary: NPM dependency lockfile v3 pinning exact versions for project-intel-mcp-server v1.6.1.0. Locks @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0 and zod 3.25.76 as core dependencies. Contains 200+ transitive dependencies for express, typescript, vitest, and various build/dev tools. Ensures deterministic installs across environments.

NPM package configuration for project-intel-mcp-server v1.4.3. Defines production dependencies (MCP SDK, Zod), development dependencies (TypeScript, Vitest), build/test scripts, and binary entry point. Requires Node.js >= v22.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/sessi.summary: Session-start hook that checks for existing project knowledge and suggests scanning if missing. Outputs HookResponse JSON with status and recommendations. Reads ENV_INCLUDE_PATHS and ENV_EXCLUDE_PATHS for config.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/tscon.summary: TypeScript compiler config targeting ES2022, NodeNext modules. Strict mode enabled with noUnused* and no* checks. Includes lib/** and root ts files, excludes node_modules/dist. Generates source maps, declarations. Enables exact optional properties and unknown catch variables for type safety.

plugins/project-intel-tool/scripts/types.summary: Zod-validated type definitions and constants for the entire project-intel system. Defines FileSummary, SummariesData, SamplingBatch, output formats, and configuration schema. Central contract for all modules.

README.md.summary: Root project README for better-base-tools. High-level overview of the plugin collection: batch_file_tools (multi-file I/O reducing tool calls 58% and tokens 46%) and project-intel-tool (persistent knowledge base for efficient exploration). Includes installation instructions via Claude Code marketplace and links to individual plugin documentation.
